scope: T2 OCI golden: an overlay of the k3s golden, dedicated and disposable; podman, buildah and every image build and push run only inside twins booted from it, against the twin's own registry; no shared Incus/Kubernetes/registry/tunnel/deploy state
recipe: incus exec k1 -- timeout 600 sh -c 'until k3s kubectl get --raw=/readyz >/dev/null 2>&1 && k3s kubectl get node k1 >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 2; done' && incus exec k1 -- k3s kubectl wait --for=condition=Ready node/k1 --timeout=600s && incus exec k1 -- k3s kubectl -n kube-system rollout status deploy/coredns --timeout=600s && incus exec k1 -- k3s kubectl -n kube-system rollout status deploy/local-path-provisioner --timeout=600s
incus exec k1 -- k3s kubectl -n registry rollout status deploy/opute-registry --timeout=600s
test "$(incus list k1 -c 4 --format csv | grep -o '10\.0\.100\.[0-9]*')" = 10.0.100.113 && incus config device override k1 eth0 ipv4.address=10.0.100.113

for u in $(systemctl list-unit-files --type=timer --state=enabled --no-legend | awk '{print $1}'); do systemctl disable --now "$u" >/dev/null 2>&1; done; systemctl mask fwupd-refresh.timer fwupd-refresh.service >/dev/null 2>&1; true

install -d -o ubuntu -g ubuntu -m 0700 /tmp/parity-oci && cd /tmp/parity-oci && for name in old shared; do install -d -o ubuntu -g ubuntu "$name" && printf 'FROM scratch\nCOPY %s.txt /%s.txt\n' "$name" "$name" > "$name/Containerfile" && echo "parity $name" > "$name/$name.txt" && chown ubuntu:ubuntu "$name"/*; done && env -u XDG_RUNTIME_DIR -u DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS runuser -u ubuntu -- sh -c 'cd ~ && podman build -q --timestamp 1000000000 -t localhost/parity/old:1 /tmp/parity-oci/old && podman build -q --timestamp 1100000000 -t localhost/parity/shared:1 /tmp/parity-oci/shared && podman tag localhost/parity/shared:1 localhost/parity/shared:rollback' && rm -rf /tmp/parity-oci

out=$(env -u XDG_RUNTIME_DIR -u DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS runuser -u ubuntu -- sh -c 'cd ~ && podman info --format json 2>&1') && printf '%s' "$out" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; json.load(sys.stdin)' || { printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -n 8 >&2; exit 1; }
